# Panos Kokmotos

> Co-Founder & COO of Givelink, an in-kind donation platform. Forbes 30 Under 30 Greece (2024) and World Economic Forum Global Shaper (San Francisco). Builds technology for social impact; based between San Francisco and Athens.

## About
- **Full name:** Panagiotis ("Panos") Kokmotos
- **Role:** Co-Founder & COO of Givelink
- **Recognition:** Forbes 30 Under 30 Greece (2024); WEF Global Shaper, San Francisco Hub
- **Based in:** San Francisco, California, USA and Athens, Greece
- **Languages:** Greek, English, French, Spanish
- **Expertise:** entrepreneurship, social impact, in-kind donations, startup fundraising, AI & technology, product management, public speaking

## Givelink
Givelink is an in-kind donation platform and mobile app that lets donors shop for the exact goods nonprofits need most, with step-by-step tracking and photo confirmation. Founded in 2022; 100+ charity partners, 100,000+ lives impacted, and $220K+ of goods delivered to nonprofits.

## Also
- Co-founder and host of **Entrepreneurship Talks**, a podcast with founders, investors, and changemakers (350K+ views, 60+ episodes).
